name: Pepperoni Pizza Popcorn
desc: Stovetop popcorn popped in rendered pepperoni fat and tossed with crisp mini pepperoni, Parmesan and a homemade pizza powder.

source.title: Pepperoni Pizza Popcorn
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 cup grated Parmesan, ground to a fine powder

steps: Make the pizza powder: pulse the 1 cup grated Parmesan in a spice grinder or small food processor until it is a fine powder, then stir in the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder and oregano.

Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot (about 6 quarts) with a tight lid over medium heat. Add the mini pepperoni and cook, stirring often, until crisp and the fat has rendered, about 5 min. Lift the pepperoni out with a slotted spoon onto paper towels and leave the fat in the pot.
Add the popcorn kernels to the pot, cover, and cook over medium-low heat, shaking the pot every so often, until the popping slows to a few seconds between pops, 3 to 5 min. Take the pot off the heat.

Tip the popcorn into a large bowl. While it is warm, toss with the crisp pepperoni, the 1 cup finely grated Parmesan and about 1/4 cup of the pizza powder. Taste and add more powder as you like. Serve warm.
tips: The caption lists "2 tbsp garlic + onion powder"; it is split evenly here.
The pizza powder makes about 1 1/2 cups, more than one batch needs. Keep the rest in a sealed jar in the fridge.
